    <item>
      <title>LGBTQ+ people go into hiding in Senegal as hundreds are arrested</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2026/oct/15/senegal-homosexuality-criminalised-anti-lgbtq-arrests-hiv-testing-human-rights-watch</link>
      <description><p>At least 320 people detained for ‘acts against nature’ after law criminalising homosexuality toughened, HRW reports</p><p>Mass arrests, forced HIV testing and barriers to legal representation are part of an escalating crackdown against LGBTQ+ people in Senegal, according to a <a href="https://www.hrw.org/news/2026/10/12/senegal-brutal-crackdown-violates-lgbt-peoples-rights">new report</a>.</p><p>More than 320 individuals have been arrested and detained on allegations of “acts against nature” since February, <a href="https://www.hivjustice.net/cases/senegal-crackdown-on-lgbtq-people-intensifies-with-multiple-arrests/">according to HIV Justice Network</a>, an organisation quoted in the Human Rights Watch (HRW) report. Among these, at least 84 were charged with “voluntary HIV transmission”, solely on the basis of their HIV status.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2026/oct/15/senegal-homosexuality-criminalised-anti-lgbtq-arrests-hiv-testing-human-rights-watch">Continue reading...</a></description>
      <category domain="https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/global-development">Global development</category>
      <category domain="https://www.theguardian.com/world/senegal">Senegal</category>
      <category domain="https://www.theguardian.com/world/lgbt-rights">LGBTQ+ rights</category>
      <category domain="https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/human-rights">Human rights</category>
      <category domain="https://www.theguardian.com/law/human-rights">Human rights</category>
      <category domain="https://www.theguardian.com/world/anti-rights-movement">Anti-rights movement</category>
      <category domain="https://www.theguardian.com/world/africa">Africa</category>
      <category domain="https://www.theguardian.com/world/world">World news</category>
      <category domain="https://www.theguardian.com/law/law">Law</category>
      <category domain="https://www.theguardian.com/society/aids-and-hiv">Aids and HIV</category>
      <pubDate>Thu, 15 Oct 2026 08:00:25 GMT</pubDate>
      <guid>https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2026/oct/15/senegal-homosexuality-criminalised-anti-lgbtq-arrests-hiv-testing-human-rights-watch</guid>
      <media:content width="140" url="https://i.guim.co.uk/img/media/5d08247e565b832f183d37b676fe7def25b19c25/213_0_2500_2000/master/2500.jpg?width=140&quality=85&auto=format&fit=max&s=123bd8ecc615f6c5a01371cef3492c23">
        <media:credit scheme="urn:ebu">Photograph: Jane Hahn/AP</media:credit>
      </media:content>
      <media:content width="460" url="https://i.guim.co.uk/img/media/5d08247e565b832f183d37b676fe7def25b19c25/213_0_2500_2000/master/2500.jpg?width=460&quality=85&auto=format&fit=max&s=add472ae1a295f31eda15f295087bdb3">

      <title>Guinea-Bissau denies it has approved controversial vaccine trial in newborns</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/14/guinea-bissau-vaccine-hepatitis-b-trial-denial</link>
      <description><p>Health minister says government ‘did not authorize’ Danish-led hepatitis B trial in babies backed by RFK Jr</p><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/guinea-bissau">Guinea-Bissau</a> has not approved the controversial <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/society/hepatitis-b">hepatitis B</a> study in newborns that would be funded by the US government and private partners, the African country’s minister of health said on Tuesday.</p><p>The study, which would not investigate the safety or effectiveness of vaccines but would instead track “nonspecific” health outcomes like overall mortality or neurodevelopmental conditions, has been championed by Robert F Kennedy Jr, secretary of the US Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) and a longtime anti-vaccine activist.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/14/guinea-bissau-vaccine-hepatitis-b-trial-denial">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/09/navanethem-navi-pillay-wins-nobel-peace-prize</link>
      <description><p>Committee recognises work of South African who chaired UN commission that concluded Israel was guilty of genocide in Gaza</p><p></p><p>The Nobel peace prize has been awarded to Navi Pillay, the South African former UN human rights chief who chaired the UN commission <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/sep/16/israel-committed-genocide-in-gaza-says-un-inquiry">that concluded Israel was guilty of genocide in Gaza</a>.</p><p>The Norwegian Nobel committee said Pillay, who is serving as a judge at the international court of justice (ICJ), has “shown that legal measures can help prevent acts of war and violence”.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/09/navanethem-navi-pillay-wins-nobel-peace-prize">Continue reading...</a></description>

News from the US, Europe, Asia Pacific, Africa, Middle East, America</description><link>https://www.france24.com/en/</link><lastBuildDate>Fri, 16 Oct 2026 10:17:30 GMT</lastBuildDate><atom:link href="https://www.france24.com/en/rss" rel="self" type="application/rss+xml"/><item><category>Focus</category><title>How books are being scanned and destroyed to train artificial intelligence</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/focus/20261016-how-books-are-being-scanned-and-destroyed-to-train-artificial-intelligence</link><description>
To train artificial intelligence models, millions of physical books are being digitised and destroyed. Our colleagues at France 2 investigate this controversial practice and the risk of seeing many rare second-hand books disappear forever.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/9e6865b4-c8c3-11f1-9320-4dd8ac2cf3bf/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-NW-PKG-F2-FOCUS-USA-BOOKS-DESTROYED-FOR-AI-NO-MIX-Video-Mixdown-2-FF.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/9e6865b4-c8c3-11f1-9320-4dd8ac2cf3bf/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-NW-PKG-F2-FOCUS-USA-BOOKS-DESTROYED-FOR-AI-NO-MIX-Video-Mixdown-2-FF.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">e0a7e502-c8c4-11f1-b72d-651aad46c7cc</guid><pubDate>Fri, 16 Oct 2026 09:31:56 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>Lauren BAIN</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Shooter kills teacher, three children at Oregon elementary school</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261016-shooter-kills-teacher-three-children-at-oregon-elementary-school</link><description>
A teenager shot and killed three children and a teacher on Thursday at an elementary school in the US state of Oregon, police said, adding the assailant was later killed by an armed bystander who pursued him into the building. Officers rushed to Silver Rail Elementary in Bend, a city of about 100,000 in the nation's northwest, after reports of a shooter on campus on Thursday afternoon. The three children who died on the scene were aged five, eight and 11, said Bend police chief Mike Krantz.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/be7b77e0-c942-11f1-9e70-d1d2c32ebb87/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-20261016-101252-101424-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/be7b77e0-c942-11f1-9e70-d1d2c32ebb87/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-20261016-101252-101424-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">c3a9a0f2-c942-11f1-814a-ed933e801f48</guid><pubDate>Fri, 16 Oct 2026 09:27:58 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>US considers hitting Iran with 'Mother of All Bombs'</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261016-us-considers-hitting-iran-with-mother-of-all-bombs</link><description>
The United States is considering using its biggest non-nuclear bomb against Iran if President Donald Trump should decide to renew combat in the war that has hit a deadlock, CNN reported Thursday. Diplomatic efforts to end the conflict, which erupted with US-Israeli strikes on Iran in February, have been at an impasse since the summer. FRANCE 24's International Affairs Editor Kethevane Gorjestani tells us more.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/b30d089c-c942-11f1-bce4-d1d2c32ebb87/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-20261016-100640-101218-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/b30d089c-c942-11f1-bce4-d1d2c32ebb87/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-20261016-100640-101218-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">b82d53f4-c942-11f1-98b8-4b48cb3a1533</guid><pubDate>Fri, 16 Oct 2026 09:27:05 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Zelensky rallies European allies as Trump ties slump</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261016-zelensky-rallies-european-allies-as-trump-ties-slump</link><description>
Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky is seeking to rally European allies at a Brussels summit on Friday after saying Kyiv would no longer abide by US President Donald Trump's demands not to strike Russian oil refineries. Relations between Kyiv and Washington have soured since last week, when Trump eased sanctions on Russia in exchange for Moscow releasing large amounts of diesel onto global markets.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/6bb9cbc4-c942-11f1-87d4-d1d2c32ebb87/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-20261016-100431-100617-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/6bb9cbc4-c942-11f1-87d4-d1d2c32ebb87/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-20261016-100431-100617-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">70a87bb2-c942-11f1-a0a5-955a57be9486</guid><pubDate>Fri, 16 Oct 2026 09:21:23 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>EU leaders face budget divisions, discuss Ukraine at Brussels summit</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/video/20261016-eu-leaders-face-budget-divisions-discuss-ukraine-at-brussels-summit</link><description>
European Union leaders gathered in Brussels on Thursday for a two-day summit to discuss the bloc’s next long-term budget, continued support for Ukraine and measures to strengthen Europe’s economic competitiveness amid rising energy prices and geopolitical uncertainty. They voiced strong opposition to a new proposal for the bloc’s long-term budget, raising serious doubt about whether the key spending package will be agreed by the end of year. FRANCE 24's Dave Keating reports from Brussels.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/bfb51536-c941-11f1-a326-d1d2c32ebb87/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-20261016-100136-100404-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/bfb51536-c941-11f1-a326-d1d2c32ebb87/w:1024/p:16x9/EN-20261016-100136-100404-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">c5488afa-c941-11f1-9d61-014f8c5442e1</guid><pubDate>Fri, 16 Oct 2026 09:20:46 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item></channel></rss>

<![CDATA[ Latest from Space.com ]]> https://www.space.com/feeds.xml Fri, 16 Oct 2026 10:00:00 +0000 en <![CDATA[ It's time to reassess the size of our solar system, scientists say ]]> Two leading space scientists say there is a need to redefine the edge of the solar system by presenting a theory which states that measurements of the Milky Way's gravitational field, including its dark matter, redraws the sun's frontier.

That theory was put forward by Jim Green, former NASA chief scientist and past director of the space agency's Planetary Science Division, along with Ed Belbruno, a professor of mathematics at Yeshiva University and a senior research associate at Princeton University.

The solar system's gravitational frontier extends to nearly 3.8 light-years from the sun, they contend, roughly 241,000 astronomical units (AU), a distance that brings the "edge" of the solar system to within the same scale as the separation between neighboring stars. The edge of our solar system may be defined not by a sharp boundary, but by a "complex dance among forces, energies and trajectories," they write. Green and Belbruno recently made their case in the August 2026 issue of the magazine ROOM - the Space Journal of Asgardia.

Slow moving objects

Moreover, this theory claims that the gravitationally stable Solar Lagrange points L1 and L2 could form a type of "portal" that could funnel future interstellar visitors such as the recent comet 3I/ATLAS into the solar system, perhaps allowing scientists to capture them for future study.

"Discovering the solar-galactic center L1 location is important since slow moving objects that enter this region can be captured by our sun and become part of our solar system," Green told Space.com. "Who knows if there may be a large captured rogue planet on its way into the solar system right now," he said.

Green said there's a need to look at these newly calculated L1 and L2 locations to see what could be found. He is now in discussion about making such observations with the New Horizons spacecraft team that explored Pluto in 2015 and is now operating in the outer heliosphere.

"Even accumulated dust in this region could verify many of the calculations we have made including the extent of the dark matter in our galaxy," said Green.

Ballistic capture

"It's a really nice and significant result," Belbruno told Space.com. The ROOM article, written for a popular audience, draws from his August 2025 keynote lecture at the Niels Bohr Institute. Much of the theory also stems from Belbruno's work on permanent capture into the solar system and weak stability boundaries published in 2024 in the journal Celestial Mechanics and Dynamical Astronomy.

Belbruno authored the book Fly Me to the Moon: An Insider's Guide to the New Science of Space Travel (Princeton University Press, Princeton, 2007). In that work, he spells out how to harness low-fuel space travel he likens to "surfing the gravitational field."

"This new work represents a new application of weak stability boundary theory, first applied in 1987 to find new routes to Earth's moon, using ballistic capture for spacecraft," Belbruno said. "Now, its application is substantially extended to ballistic capture into our solar system from interstellar space and in estimating the size of our solar system," he said.

Green and Belbruno point out that the very recent discovery of interstellar objects  — such as interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS in 2025  — passing through our solar system on hyperbolic trajectories "has opened an entirely new window onto the material and processes shaping planetary systems across the galaxy."

Mastery of gravity

The article in ROOM adds some impactful ideas regarding potential distant alien civilizations.

"Interstellar travel requires a mastery of gravity, which an advanced extraterrestrial civilization might use to tour the galaxy, using portals created at Lagrange points for leverage, Green and Belbruno write.

"Remaining at these locations, they could observe the life within a stellar system with essentially no energy expenditure," the researchers add, "so perhaps we should be looking for large space stations at stellar L1 and L2 locations as a techno-signature of advanced intelligent life?"

]]> <![CDATA[ Astronomers discover the 1st ever green star, a cosmic zombie just in time for Halloween ]]> How awesome would it be if the sun could take on a spooky green glow for Halloween? It turns out that scientists have discovered that our star may indeed go green, but only billions of years from now after its death  — and only if it then starts eating planets like a cosmic zombie.

That's possible because scientists have discovered that white dwarfs, the type of stellar remnants sun-sized stars leave behind when they die, can actually take on a range of colors including green if they snack on their rocky planets like cosmic cannibals.

For stellar scientists, the colors of stars have always been indicative of their temperatures. Cool stars look orange, while stars like the sun look white, and the hottest stars glow pale blue. This is akin to a blacksmith's iron glowing red, then orange, then white-hot as it heats up. Researchers have always assumed that white dwarfs follow the same rule. However, new research suggests that these stellar corpses could glow in a range of colors including green, pink, cyan, yellow, and purple. That means the universe is far more colorful than we suspected.

"Most stars, including most white dwarfs, behave like 'perfect radiators,' so their color is set almost entirely by temperature. But nobody had really looked into what else might be possible for white dwarfs," team leader Mark Hollands of the University of Warwick said in a statement sent to Space.com.

"It turns out these incredibly dense stars caaaaan produce colors nobody expected, and some of them genuinely surprised me."

How white dwarfs break stellar color rules

White dwarfs get their name because when they were discovered, they appeared surprisingly hot and glowed white or pale blue. However, this new research suggests that this slightly bland and uniform appearance is because no white dwarf is close enough for Earthbound astronomers to see their true colors.

The key to the rainbow-like array of colors this team suggests white dwarfs could possess is their density. White dwarfs form when stars with a mass roughly that of the sun run out of fuel and can no longer support themselves against their own gravity, causing their cores to collapse. As a result, the matter that makes up white dwarfs is around the density of water, millions of times denser than the sun's surface, the photosphere.

In these conditions, elements like carbon, calcium, and sodium can interact with the surrounding dense helium plasma and absorb light across a wider range of colors than they would at lower densities. That shifts the colors of white dwarfs away from the white/light blue seen for a perfect radiator of heat.

The researchers found that the colors of white dwarfs would fit into distinct groups tied to the individual chemical makeup of the stellar remnant's atmosphere.

White dwarfs abundant in carbon should be pink or purple, while those that have been enriched with debris from consumed asteroids and comets, and the remains of old planetary systems, would take a more yellow hue. Cooler white dwarfs with mixed hydrogen and helium atmospheres often would glow cyan or pale blue, caused as hydrogen molecules collide with helium atoms in their dense atmospheres.

One of the most striking examples of white dwarf coloration, however, would arise when one of these living dead stars starts feeding on the planets around it like a horror movie zombie.

Zombie white dwarfs go green

The researchers found that some dead star white dwarfs can go a little green around the gills after snacking on orbiting planets.

An example of this is WD J1330+6435, a cool white dwarf located around 326 light-years away, which has been accreting rocky material from a planetary companion. This has enriched its atmosphere with calcium, lithium, and sodium, and the team's model suggests this would have led WD J1330+6435 to adopt a green hue.

But unlike the green-tinged zombies of George Romero's classic Dawn of the Dead, there are no hordes of these green-faced cosmic zombies ... yet.

The researchers think that no other star, living or dead, has ever been credibly reported as green. That makes WD J1330+6435 the first known genuinely green star.

"The traces of sodium in the atmosphere of this white dwarf absorb the orange part of the spectrum, leaving behind a ghostly green glow," Hollands said. "Imagine standing on a planet and looking up at a green star. It feels like something out of science fiction."

Scientists see red

The team didn't just discover that a known white dwarf is the first-ever green star; they also discovered what could be the reddest star ever in the form of the white dwarf WD J1011+2845.

Located just 48 light-years from Earth, this white dwarf has a deep convection zone that carries carbon from its core to its surface. These carbon molecules distort light from the white dwarf, causing a deep salmon-pink glow unlike anything seen in any other star.

Despite this rainbow of white dwarfs, the team theorizes that white is still the most common color for these stellar corpses. Only five of the 151 white dwarfs within around 65 light-years of Earth have extraordinary coloring. Extrapolating this to the total population of white dwarfs, the team estimates that only one in 30 of these dead stars has an unusual color.

"One in thirty might not sound like a huge fraction, but across the entire population of white dwarfs in the universe, that is still a lot of oddly colored stars out there," Boris Gänsicke, Department of Physics, University of Warwick, said. "Yet if we take the median across a representative population of white dwarfs, we found that the average white dwarf really is white."

The team's research was published on Thursday (Oct. 14) in the journal RAS Techniques and Instruments.

That shifts the colors of white dwarfs away from the white/light blue seen for a perfect radiator of heat.

The researchers found that the colors of white dwarfs would fit into distinct groups tied to the individual chemical makeup of the stellar remnant's atmosphere.

White dwarfs abundant in carbon should be pink or purple, while those that have been enriched with debris from consumed asteroids and comets, and the remains of old planetary systems, would take a more yellow hue. Cooler white dwarfs with mixed hydrogen and helium atmospheres often would glow cyan or pale blue, caused as hydrogen molecules collide with helium atoms in their dense atmospheres.

One of the most striking examples of white dwarf coloration, however, would arise when one of these living dead stars starts feeding on the planets around it like a horror movie zombie.

Zombie white dwarfs go green

The researchers found that some dead star white dwarfs can go a little green around the gills after snacking on orbiting planets.

An example of this is WD J1330+6435, a cool white dwarf located around 326 light-years away, which has been accreting rocky material from a planetary companion. This has enriched its atmosphere with calcium, lithium, and sodium, and the team's model suggests this would have led WD J1330+6435 to adopt a green hue.

But unlike the green-tinged zombies of George Romero's classic Dawn of the Dead, there are no hordes of these green-faced cosmic zombies ... yet.

The researchers think that no other star, living or dead, has ever been credibly reported as green. That makes WD J1330+6435 the first known genuinely green star.

"The traces of sodium in the atmosphere of this white dwarf absorb the orange part of the spectrum, leaving behind a ghostly green glow," Hollands said. "Imagine standing on a planet and looking up at a green star. It feels like something out of science fiction."

The team didn't just discover that a known white dwarf is the first-ever green star; they also discovered what could be the reddest star ever in the form of the white dwarf WD J1011+2845.

Located just 48 light-years from Earth, this white dwarf has a deep convection zone that carries carbon from its core to its surface. These carbon molecules distort light from the white dwarf, causing a deep salmon-pink glow unlike anything seen in any other star.

Despite this rainbow of white dwarfs, the team theorizes that white is still the most common color for these stellar corpses. Only five of the 151 white dwarfs within around 65 light-years of Earth have extraordinary coloring. Extrapolating this to the total population of white dwarfs, the team estimates that only one in 30 of these dead stars has an unusual color.

"One in thirty might not sound like a huge fraction, but across the entire population of white dwarfs in the universe, that is still a lot of oddly colored stars out there," Boris Gänsicke, Department of Physics, University of Warwick, said. "Yet if we take the median across a representative population of white dwarfs, we found that the average white dwarf really is white."

The team's research was published on Thursday (Oct. 14) in the journal RAS Techniques and Instruments.

]]> <![CDATA[ On this day in space! Oct. 15, 1997: NASA launches Cassini-Hugyens probe on 7-year voyage to Saturn ]]>

On Oct. 15, 1997, NASA launched the Cassini spacecraft on a mission to explore Saturn and its moons. It lifted off aboard a Titan 4B rocket from Cape Canaveral Air Force Station in Florida.

It took almost seven years for the Cassini spacecraft to reach Saturn, with the spacecraft entering orbit around the ringed planet in 2004. Another smaller spacecraft called Huygens hitched a ride with Cassini, and it landed on Saturn's moon Titan in 2005.

Cassini spent 13 years studying the Saturn system up close, and the mission lasted about 20 years before coming to an epic grand finale on Sept. 15, 2017.

Running low on fuel, NASA chose to steer Cassini straight into Saturn's atmosphere, where the spacecraft was destroyed.

Why it mattered

NASA's Cassini mission to Saturn (which carried the European Space Agency's Huygens lander to Titan) was a flagship planetary mission like no other ever when it first launched toward the ringed planet.

The $3.26 billion Cassini spacecraft became the first probe ever to orbit Saturn when it arrived in 2004. It revealed Saturn's rings as active and dynamic structures, as intricate and complex as they are beautiful to observe.

And it delivered Huygens to Titan, then followed up with a series of Titan flybys that revealed the cloudy moon could have liquid hydrocarbon rain, rivers, lakes and seas.

Perhaps the most exciting discoveries were the most surprising.

Cassini discovered a strange hexagon-shaped jetstream encircling Saturn's north pole and revealed massive hurricane-like vortexes over both of the planet's poles. In 2010, Cassini watched as a giant storm formed in Saturn's northern hemisphere, then grew to encircle the entire planet through 2011.

The spacecraft also discovered icy plumes of water erupting from Saturn's moon Enceladus, revealing new clues into that moon's subsurface ocean of liquid water, complete with hydrothermal events like those found in Earth's oceans.

It was to protect Enceladus, Titan and other Saturn moons that NASA ultimated sent Cassini into a death dive into Saturn at the end of its mission. The space agency wanted to prevent any chance of contamination at those pristine moons.

"NASA’s Cassini spacecraft and ESA’s Huygens probe expanded our understanding of the kinds of worlds where life might exist and eight more reasons the mission changed the course of planetary exploration," NASA said in an overview.

]]> <![CDATA[ SpaceX launches classified mission for the US Space Force (video) ]]>

SpaceX launched a classified mission for the U.S. Space Force from California this evening (Oct. 15).

A Falcon 9 rocket lifted off from Vandenberg Space Force Base today at 8:01 p.m. EDT (5:01 p.m. local time; 0001 GMT on Oct. 16), rising into clear blue skies above the Golden State's central coast.

Such visibly striking launches are far from guaranteed; Vandenberg and its scenic surroundings are often blanketed by fog, making rocket watching in the area a dicey proposition.

This evening's launch kicked off the USSF-481 mission, which is delivering mysterious payloads to an undisclosed location in the final frontier.

SpaceX didn't provide much more info during its launch webcast; it ended just after the Falcon 9 first stage's landing, which occurred as planned about 8.5 minutes after launch on the drone ship "Of Course I Still Love You," which was stationed in the Pacific Ocean.

USSF-481 was the 28th flight for this particular booster, which is designated 1081. Sixteen of its previous 27 launches were devoted to building out SpaceX's Starlink broadband megaconstellation in low Earth orbit, according to a SpaceX mission description.

Previous Booster 1081 missions

Crew-7 | CRS-29 | PACE | Transporter-10 | EarthCARE | NROL-186 | Transporter-13 | TRACERS | NROL-48 | COSMO-SkyMed Second Generation FM3 | 16 Starlink missions

USSF-481 was the 114th Falcon 9 mission of the year. The vast majority of the rocket's flights in 2026 — more than 70% of them — have been Starlink missions.

SpaceX has also launched its Falcon Heavy and Starship rockets three times so far this year. Falcon Heavy is an operational vehicle, but the fully reusable Starship remains in the test-flight phase. It reached orbit for the first time on its most recent launch, which occurred on Sept. 28.

Editor's note: This story was updated at 8:30 p.m. ET on Oct. 15 with news of successful launch and rocket landing.

]]> <![CDATA[ NASA's SkyFall helicopters will 'show us parts of Mars we've never seen before', scientists say ]]> NASA is accelerating the development of three helicopters that will be deployed into the sky above Mars after a voyage aboard NASA's Space Reactor‑1 Freedom spacecraft.

Slated for launch in 2028, SR-1 Freedom is the first fission nuclear-powered interplanetary spacecraft and is assigned the duty of dropping off the SkyFall entry capsule loaded with the trio of aerial vehicles at the Red Planet. SR-1's trajectory will deliver the SkyFall helicopters in Mars' northern hemisphere during the planet's spring season to avoid dust storms.

SkyFall is based on the success of the first aerial craft to float about the Red Planet, Ingenuity, which flew over 70 missions at Jezero Crater before it finally broke a rotor. It was designed to fly five. The SkyFall mission will consist of three identical helicopters to be deployed by an entry vehicle in the atmosphere, let loose at roughly under a mile (3,300 feet or 1,000 meters) above Mars, with each of the craft landing independently.

Regions of interest

The SkyFall mission is to conduct investigations that address objectives relevant for science and preparing for human exploration of Mars. Anticipated flights of the vehicles will travel outside of the landing ellipse to regions of interest within a broader exploration zone.

However, there are further science-focused flight paths and regions that have yet to be determined. NASA intends for the SkyFall helicopters to go to multiple regions of scientific interest on Mars.

NASA's Mars Exploration Program, along with the SkyFall project at the Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL), will work together to pick those "why and where" paths to navigate.

A first workshop on potential landing sites for the SkyFall mission and adjacent exploration zones of high scientific value is slated for early next year. And as always, sites and zones on Mars for the choppers means satisfying engineering constraints imposed by the project and spacecraft design.

Given the rapid development cadence of the SkyFall mission, decisions are to be fast-paced, but are geared to maximizing science value of the endeavor.

What Mars researchers are after will be a ranked list of potential landing sites that will be studied in more detail by the SkyFall project and science community, prior to a second workshop to be held in late 2027.

Notional flight trajectories

On the table are potential science value and notional flight trajectories of individual landing sites given the capabilities and payload of the SkyFall helicopters.

Landing site selection will occur after the back-to-back landing site workshops next year, said Matthew Golombek, SkyFall Project Scientist at JPL.

"The project has identified a design reference landing site that targets subsurface water ice deposits with glacial/periglacial terrains," Golombek told Space.com.

Given their deployment, how much real estate will the aerial vessel assault study?

Golombek said that the helicopters are capable of flying one to two kilometers every other sol, so flight traverses of 125 miles to a little over 185 miles (200-300 kilometers) are possible.

"The helicopters are designed to last 6 months, with a goal of one Earth year and each can fly every other sol so multiple flights are expected," Golombek added.

Thanks to the success of the Perseverance rover's unleashing of the Ingenuity rotorcraft, Golombek said that there are a host of lessons learned, as well as engineering additions to be made to the set of SkyFall vehicles.

Nominal payload

"Although the helicopters are slightly larger than Ingenuity, they are being designed to operate in exactly the same way, so all of the experience with Ingenuity operations will be directly relevant," said Golombek.

The nominal payload to be toted around the Red Planet will be identical for all three helicopters, consisting of five instruments, plus engineering navigation cameras. Those instruments are to investigate the subsurface structure of Mars, the geomorphology and geology of surface terrains, as well as look at the meteorology of the atmosphere and the radiation environment.

Although there is no dedicated hardware to directly measure winds, the helicopters themselves can serve as on-the-spot wind sensors, even shifting to "Balloon Mode," whereby a helicopter will drift in the background wind.

Radar love

Each low-flying helicopter is outfitted with a ground penetrating radar (GPR) instrument, one that can detect layering in the near surface, at depths unobservable by orbital radar.

Those layers could be assembled from rocky material, buried ice, or combinations of the two. Detection of near-surface ice is of interest both scientifically as well as in support of future human expeditions to Mars.

Subsurface ice not only preserves a record of past Martian climate but also serves as a "high-priority environment" that might have served as a habitat of past…or Martian life resident today.

SkyFall maneuver

AeroVironment of Arlington, Virginia is partnering with JPL, selected last August to co-design and co-manufacture the SkyFall helicopters. They too are building on their experience as co‑developers of NASA's Ingenuity Mars helicopter that made those 72 flights at Jezero Crater on Mars.

"Now, with SkyFall, we're taking AV's high‑volume uncrewed systems mindset into planetary exploration and showing that Mars helicopters can be built as a repeatable product line, not a one‑off delivery," said Jeff Rodrian, Head of MacCready Works, AV's advanced research and development organization.

A special "SkyFall maneuver" is to be utilized in deploying the three aerial craft. They will be released directly from the carrier spacecraft into the Martian atmosphere, where they separate, deploy, descend, and land under their own power.

"By eliminating the need for a single-use lander stage or a host rover (as Ingenuity required with Perseverance), this approach significantly reduces the technical and financial risk of getting to the Martian surface," explains an AeroVironment statement.

Mountains of data

"Just like here on Earth, Mars helicopters can cover distance quickly and can go places that might be impossible to reach by ground," said Will Pomerantz, Head of Space Ventures at AeroVironment.

The science community may guide these helicopters to locations, Pomerantz said, where the ground penetrating radar can map out the specific spots of ice below the martian surface.

"The three SkyFall helicopters are going to show us parts of Mars we've never seen before and return mountains of data for scientists to pore over," said Pomerantz.

"By eliminating the need for a single-use lander stage or a host rover (as Ingenuity required with Perseverance), this approach significantly reduces the technical and financial risk of getting to the Martian surface," explains an AeroVironment statement.

"Just like here on Earth, Mars helicopters can cover distance quickly and can go places that might be impossible to reach by ground," said Will Pomerantz, Head of Space Ventures at AeroVironment.

The science community may guide these helicopters to locations, Pomerantz said, where the ground penetrating radar can map out the specific spots of ice below the martian surface.

]]> <![CDATA[ Windblown yardangs on Mars | Space photo of the day for Oct. 15, 2026 ]]>

A new image from the European Space Agency's Mars Express spacecraft reveals the powerful erosive forces that have shaped and re-shaped the surface of the Red Planet over long periods of geological time.

What is it?

This new Mars Express image captures Amazonis Mensa, a large, flat mountain on the Red Planet that offers planetary scientists a glimpse into the many factors that can sculpt a world's surface.

In this photograph, several features stand out to help illustrate this. Easiest to make out are the large round craters created by ancient impacts on the surface of Mars. However, many of these craters have been at least partially filled by lava flowing across the surface of the Red Planet around three billion years ago, according a statement from the European Space Agency (ESA) accompanying the image.

More interestingly, rippled structures known as yardangs can be seen to the left and right sides of the image. These ridges "form as loose sand particles are whipped up by wind and deployed a little like a cosmic sandblaster," according to ESA.

In the image, the two groups of yardangs ripple across the Martian surface in two different directions. This is because Amazonis Mensa acts as a windbreak, pushing material blown by winds in separate orientations.

Why is it incredible?

For over 20 years, Mars Express has been providing scientists with an unparalleled look at the Martian surface, helping us better understand the forces that have shaped the Red Planet over eons.

]]> <![CDATA[ Scientists discover 'chemical starter kit' for life in planetary birthplaces ]]> Methanol, coming as part of the 'chemical starter kit' around young stars, has produced some unexpected surprises that could ultimately reveal some of the conditions in which planets and potentially life form around protostars.

The methanol discoveries were made by astronomers using ALMA (the Atacama Large millimeter/submillimeter Array) in the Atacama Desert in Chile, as part of a project called COMPASS (the Complex Organic Molecules in Protostars with ALMA Spectral Surveys).

"Our work provides insight into the complex chemistry of young star systems and is ultimately an important piece of the puzzle in understanding the origin of life," said University of Bern astrophysicist Maria Drozdovskaya, who leads the COMPASS project, in a statement.

Drozdovskaya's multinational team of more than 30 astronomers has been chasing down complex organic molecules, large molecules that include carbon atoms, in the planetary construction yards around eleven young stars.

These molecules form part of the chemical inventory that ultimately builds planets and, perhaps, even life that will one day live on those planets.

Methanol matters

Methanol (CH3OH) is important because it is highly abundant in star- and planet-forming regions. In fact, it’s the most abundant complex organic molecule to be found in interstellar space, and is commonly found in planet-forming disks.

Its sheer abundance means that, of all the molecules found around young stars, methanol is the easiest in which to detect different forms where regular hydrogen atoms are replaced by a heavier isotope of hydrogen called deuterium.

How many molecules contain these heavier isotopes is highly dependent upon the conditions in which planets are forming within the disk.

That’s why the COMPASS team used ALMA to search for these forms of methanol in the gas belonging to the planet-forming disks around the 11 nearby low-mass protostars. The observations have also helped assess the general chemical diversity of these disks.

The unexpected discovery of a methanol molecule containing deuterium was made in the planet-forming disk around only one of those 11 stars, namely the young star IRAS 4A2, located about a thousand light-years away in the Perseus Molecular Cloud.

IRAS refers to the Infrared Astronomical Satellite, which was a joint NASA–UK–Netherlands mission launched in 1983 and which first detected this young star as a source of infrared light through the thick gas and dust of the molecular cloud.

The COMPASS team also discovered methanol maser emission from more than half of the 11 protostars, favoring the youngest of the stars. A maser is a microwave version of a laser in the sense that the microwave emission is being stimulated and then amplified, but astrophysical masers occur naturally, often in shock fronts as methanol molecules collide and are excited.

Methanol masers have previously been detected in planet-forming disks around turbulent high-mass protostars, but COMPASS’ observations are the first detection of them around calmer lower-mass protostars.

"The fact that it has now also been found in a low-mass protostar shows that locally extreme physical conditions can prevail there analogously to massive stars and challenges our previous understanding of the formation of sun-like stars," said Drozdovskaya.

The finding implies that methanol masers are a common product of all planet-forming discs and therefore are produced by processes that are universal in star- and planet-birth, regardless of the protostar's mass.

For example, thermal bursts from the growing star as it accumulates gas from its surroundings could generate shocks in a planet-forming disk, stimulating maser activity in the abundant methanol.

"Both results underscore how important high-performance spectroscopic measurements like those from COMPASS with ALMA are for detecting rare and previously unknown chemical phenomena," said Drozdovskaya, referring to both the methanol masers and the deuterium-rich methanol molecules around IRAS 4A2. "They show just how much we still have to learn about the chemical processes in young protostellar systems."

The new findings have at least begun to answer some questions, such as how the diversity in this 'chemical starter kit' varies from star to star, with ALMA detecting some subtle differences, such as variations in the abundance of oxygen- and nitrogen-bearing molecular species among the eleven stars.

However, questions about how the chemistry of young star systems arises and how it influences the evolution of those systems remain unanswered.

For now, the COMPASS team is painstakingly and systematically studying the data on all the different types of molecules detected in their ALMA observations, and preparing follow-up studies with other facilities including the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST).

"The analysis of all the collected data will take several more years," said Drozdovskaya.

The first results from COMPASS are published in seven papers [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7] in the October 2026 issue of the journal Astronomy & Astrophysics.

]]> <![CDATA[ SpaceX wants to launch Starship more than 450 times per year from South Texas ]]> SpaceX wants to start flying its Starship megarocket a lot more often.

The company has requested permission to launch Starship from its Starbase site in South Texas up to 456 times per year. That's a big jump from the currently allowed cadence of 25.

The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) is in the early stages of reviewing the request. Today (Oct. 14), the agency announced "its intent to prepare a Programmatic Environmental Impact Statement, open a public scoping period and hold public scoping meetings for SpaceX’s proposal."

Starship, which stands more than 400 feet (122 meters) tall, is the biggest and most powerful rocket ever built. It's also designed to be fully and rapidly reusable, a breakthrough that SpaceX believes will revolutionize spaceflight.

The megarocket has flown 14 times to date, all of them test flights from Starbase, which is near the Texas border city of Brownsville. On the most recent jaunt, which lifted off on Sept. 28, Starship reached orbit for the first time and deployed 26 Starlink V3 satellites — the first members of a new broadband constellation that could eventually consist of 100,000 spacecraft.

Assembling that network will require a lot of Starship launches. And even more will be needed to build SpaceX's planned Starmind AI megaconstellation, which Elon Musk has said will harbor a million satellites. Indeed, the world's richest man has said that SpaceX is targeting more than 10,000 Starship liftoffs per year by 2030.

Not all of those flights will originate from Starbase, which hosts two orbital pads. SpaceX is working to get three Starship pads up and running on Florida's Space Coast, and the company aims to break ground on a $100 billion, 12-pad complex in Louisiana next year.

Each operational Starship launch will also feature two landings. Both of the vehicle's elements — the Super Heavy booster and Ship upper stage — are designed to return to the pad after liftoff, where they will be caught by the tower's "chopstick" arms. So SpaceX's proposal for 456 launches from Starbase per year includes a request for approval for 912 landings.

SpaceX plans to work up to this cadence in two phases, according to the FAA. Phase 1 "would include up to 100 annual launches and up to 200 annual landings (100 of Starship and 100 of Super Heavy)," the agency wrote. "Launches and landings could occur any day or time of the week."

Phase 2 covers 456 launches and 912 landings, which would occur only Monday through Friday, though at any time on those days.

The FAA will hold five "public scoping meetings" about the proposal next month, four of them in person in the Starbase area and one of them virtual.

There will be two in-person meetings on Nov. 17 at Texas Southmost College, one from 1-3 p.m. local (Central) time and the other from 5:30-7:30 p.m. Two in-person meetings will follow on Nov. 19, at the same two times but at a different location: the Port Isabel Event & Cultural Center.

The virtual meeting will be held Nov. 18, from 5:30-7:30 p.m. Central time. Registration is required for all of these meetings, even the virtual one. You can register here.

 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-domov/pocet-kyberincidentu-behem-zari-byl-nadprumerny-utocnici-cili-hlavne-na_2610161110_kvr</link>
 <description>Počet kybernetických incidentů v Česku byl v září nadprůměrný. Národní úřad pro kybernetickou a informační bezpečnost (NÚKIB) jich evidoval 26, což je třetí nejvyšší počet za poslední rok, informoval na webu. Nejvíce jich bylo v lednu, a to 32. Druhý nejvyšší počet evidoval v srpnu, a to 28. Za loňský rok je měsíční průměr zhruba 17 kybernetických incidentů, úřad jich dohromady evidoval 203.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/images/8bd05b51f00024ab1fa8a5b7eeec690d.jpg?itok=1r0Pqfsx" type="image/jpeg" />
 <pubDate>Fri, 16 Oct 2026 11:10:00 +0200</pubDate>
</item>
<item>
 <title>Přípravy na zimu vrcholí. Ve Stupavě zahájí lyžařskou sezonu s novým osvětlením a horní částí vleku</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-domov/pripravy-na-zimu-vrcholi-ve-stupave-zahaji-lyzarskou-sezonu-s-novym-osvetlenim-a_2610161107_tez</link>
 <description>Ve Stupavě na Uherskohradišťsku se připravují na zimní sezonu. Kontrolují a opravují vleky, zasněžovací techniku a jednotlivá děla. Zimní období zahájí s novými turnikety, horní částí vleku a zrekonstruovaným osvětlením, které umožní lepší viditelnost při nočním lyžování. Zasněžovat by chtěli začít v listopadu, vše se ale bude odvíjet od počasí.</description>

</item>
<item>

   <description>Překvapení, jaké Zrádci nejspíš nezažili. Do pátého dílu detektivní show na Primě nečekaně vstoupili Ewa Farna a Mirai. Šel z nich skutečný strach - vypadali totiž jako příchozí ze záhrobí. Proměna byla dokonalá.</description>

  <item>
   <title>Hrůza v obci na Plzeňsku: Propuštěný vrah znásilnil a uškrtil vlastní matku</title>
   <link>https://plzensky.denik.cz/krimi/vrah-herbrych-matka-znasilneni-dozivoti-pribehy-zla-plzensko/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed-vse&utm_campaign=ceskolipsky.denik.cz&utm_content=krimi</link>
   <description>Vladimír Herbrych ze Sokolovska byl ve vážných problémech už od mládí. Když mu bylo 32 let, zabil v Praze 83letou Žofii D. Po propuštění z vězení mu poskytla azyl jeho matka Žofie S., která ho nechala bydlet u sebe v Sedlci u Starého Plzence na Plzeňsku. Odvděčil se jí tím, že ji po hádce také zavraždil. A znásilnil a okradl. Příběh dvojnásobného vraha Herbrycha, který byl odsouzen na doživotí, je dalším pokračováním seriálu Deníku Příběhy zla.</description>
   <pubDate>Fri, 16 Oct 2026 11:00:00 +0200</pubDate>
   <guid>https://plzensky.denik.cz/krimi/vrah-herbrych-matka-znasilneni-dozivoti-pribehy-zla-plzensko/</guid>
   <category>Krimi</category>
   <enclosure url="https://ceskolipsky.denik.cz/images/api/image/1366x768/cff/cfff7fcf-5401-420c-a650-55250bd25eb2.jpeg" length="0" type="image/jpeg"/>

    <media:description>Dům v Sedlci, kde Hebrych zavraždil svoji matku. Dnes už tu žijí lidé, kteří s tragédií nemají nic společného.</media:description>
    <media:credit>Petr Eret</media:credit>

   <description>Hostem podcastu O životě zblízka byla docentka a psycholožka Markéta Švamberk Šauerová, autorka knihy Adolescent se speciálními vzdělávacími potřebami.   <item>
   <title>Bydlí ve stanu i desítky let. Najdeme tu seniory i těhotné, upozorňují teréňáci</title>
   <link>https://www.denik.cz/cesko/cesko-socialni-problemy-duchodci-i-tehotne-bydli-ve-stanu-i-desitky-let/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed-vse&utm_campaign=ceskolipsky.denik.cz&utm_content=cesko</link>
   <description>V příměstských oblastech Mostu, Litvínova či Duchcova žije ve stanových městečkách stále více lidí, kteří nenacházejí místo v sociálních zařízeních. Důvodem bývají pravidla azylových domů zakazující alkohol, psy nebo společné bydlení partnerů. Města jejich existenci tolerují a snaží se jim život neztěžovat, řešením by však podle neziskovek bylo dostupné sociální bydlení či provizorní pobytová zařízení.</description>

  <item>
   <title>ON-LINE: O nových senátorech rozhodne 2. kolo. Kdo je mezi kandidáty?</title>
   <link>https://www.denik.cz/senatni-volby/senatni-volby-2026-vysledky-2-kolo-hlasy-novi-senatori-slozeni-senatu/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed-vse&utm_campaign=ceskolipsky.denik.cz&utm_content=senatni-volby</link>
   <description>Senátní volby 2026 rozhodnou, kdo na následujících šest let usedne v Senátu České republiky. Z prvního kola hlasování vzešlo pět senátorů, kteří získali nad 50 procent hlasů voličů. Ve zbylých okrscích postoupili vždy dva kandidáti s nejvyšším počtem hlasů. Ve druhém kole mohou občané volit v pátek 16. října od 14:00 do 22:00 hodin a v sobotu 17. října od 8:00 do 14:00 hodin.</description>

  <item>
   <title>Lehký jídlo není shnilý jídlo, vytkl Pohlreich. U Kaštanu přesto hvězdu dostali</title>
   <link>https://www.denik.cz/kultura/ano-sefe-zdenek-pohlreich-hospudka-u-kastanu-jencice/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed-vse&utm_campaign=ceskolipsky.denik.cz&utm_content=kultura</link>
   <description>Zdeněk Pohlreich se vrátil do hospůdky U Kaštanu v Jenčicích, jejíž majitel se pokoušel proměnit svůj sen ve fungující restauraci. Kontrolní ochutnávka dopadla překvapivě dobře. Přestože šéf našel na talíři zvadlý list salátu a kuchařům vytkl nedostatek praxe, nakonec jim udělil jednu hvězdu. Především proto, že jídlo konečně mělo chuť.</description>
   <pubDate>Fri, 16 Oct 2026 04:30:00 +0200</pubDate>
   <guid>https://www.denik.cz/kultura/ano-sefe-zdenek-pohlreich-hospudka-u-kastanu-jencice/</guid>

      <title>GLOSA: Můžeme nemluvit o tom kreténovi? Waters se pustil do Hetfielda z Metalliky</title>

      <description>Roger Waters už zřejmě neví, koho by ještě urazil a jak moc by naštval soudně smýšlející fanoušky Pink Floyd. Aktuálně se pustil do Jamese Hetfielda z Metalliky. Mimo jiné o něm prohlásil, že je nula, kretén s IQ 3 a že neumí pořádně hrát. </description>

    <item>
      <title>Přehledně: Od „neúčasti“ u voleb po účet za lety. Co víme o Pavlově dovolené</title>
      <link>https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/domaci/petr-pavel-dovolena-maroko-soukroma-cesta-volby-penize-kritika-prezident.A261016_090139_domaci_ikro#utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed&utm_campaign=zpravodaj&utm_content=main</link>
      <description>Prezident Petr Pavel odjel na začátku října na soukromou dovolenou do Maroka. Z plánovaného odpočinku se ale stalo politické téma, protože Pavel původně plánoval vynechat obecní volby. Nakonec ale změnil názor a na otočku se vrátil soukromým letadlem do Česka, aby odvolil. Pozornost pak vzbudily i náklady na lety či prezidentovi spolucestující. Po návratu z cesty Pavel zveřejnil, kolik za dopravu zaplatil. Přinášíme přehled celé kauzy.</description>
      <pubDate>Fri, 16 Oct 2026 10:09:00 GMT</pubDate>

    <item>
      <title>Při prodeji alkoholu online navrhli poslanci hlídat, že je kupujícímu už 18 let</title>
      <link>https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/domaci/u-online-prodeje-alkoholu-navrhuji-poslanci-prisneji-hlidat-vek-kupujiciho.A261016_080620_domaci_kop#utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed&utm_campaign=zpravodaj&utm_content=main</link>
      <description>Poslanci tří opozičních stran – hnutí STAN, lidovců a Pirátů – společně navrhují, aby u online prodeje alkoholu musel prodejce mnohem lépe hlídat věku toho, kdo alkohol kupuje. Michaela Šebelová z hnutí STAN a další prosazují, aby musel být prodejce vybaven počítačovým systémem, který elektronicky jednoznačně ověří, že kupujícímu není méně než 18 let. A bude to muset ověřit i při předání.</description>
      <pubDate>Fri, 16 Oct 2026 10:08:32 GMT</pubDate>
      <category domain="https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/domaci">Zprávy - Domácí</category>
      <comments>https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/domaci/u-online-prodeje-alkoholu-navrhuji-poslanci-prisneji-hlidat-vek-kupujiciho.A261016_080620_domaci_kop/diskuse</comments>
      <guid isPermaLink="false">A261016_080620_domaci_kop</guid>
      <media:content url="https://1gr.cz/fotky/idnes/26/102/cl6/HEL54ac77c047_Snemovna_prodej_alkoholu.jpg" type="image/jpeg" />
      <media:description>U online prodeje alkoholu navrhují poslanci přísněji hlídat věk kupujícího</media:description>
      <media:credit>PSP ČR</media:credit>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>Jak volit ve druhém kole voleb do Senátu 2026? Vyberte jediný hlasovací lístek</title>
      <link>https://www.idnes.cz/volby/jak-volit-ve-druhem-kole-voleb-do-senatu-2026-vyberte-jediny-hlasovaci-listek.A261016_094438_volby_pzak#utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed&utm_campaign=zpravodaj&utm_content=main</link>
      <description>Druhé kolo voleb do Senátu začne dnes ve 14 hodin ve 22 volebních obvodech. Voliči se budou v každém z nich rozhodovat pro jednoho ze dvou kandidátů. Na rozdíl od prvního kola voleb se volební lístky nedodávají do poštovních schránek. A jiná je také barva obálky. Jak správně volit? </description>
      <pubDate>Fri, 16 Oct 2026 10:00:00 GMT</pubDate>
      <category domain="https://www.idnes.cz/volby">Zprávy - Volby</category>
      <comments>https://www.idnes.cz/volby/jak-volit-ve-druhem-kole-voleb-do-senatu-2026-vyberte-jediny-hlasovaci-listek.A261016_094438_volby_pzak/diskuse</comments>

      <media:content url="https://1gr.cz/fotky/idnes/24/093/cl6/DAV7854809866_030313_7881461.jpg" type="image/jpeg" />
      <media:description>Druhé kolo voleb do Senátu už nemá žluté obálky. </media:description>
      <media:credit>MAFRA</media:credit>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>Směšná výmluva, tepe Rajchl Pavla za vyčíslení dovolené. Opozice prezidentovi věří</title>
      <link>https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/domaci/petr-pavel-maroko-dovolena-cesta-rajchl-kupka-rakusan.A261016_105830_domaci_ikro#utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed&utm_campaign=zpravodaj&utm_content=main</link>
      <description>Prezident Petr Pavel zveřejnil náklady na svou soukromou cestu do Maroka a vysvětlil, že si ji hradil sám. Zatímco opoziční politici jeho vyjádření považují za dostatečné a věc za uzavřenou, poslanec Jindřich Rajchl (za SPD) prezidentovo vysvětlení zpochybňuje. Vadí mu mimo jiné cena soukromého letu a požaduje také informace o nákladech na cestu prezidentovy ochranky.</description>

      <media:description>Prezident Petr Pavel poskytl rozhovor pro iDNES.cz, ve kterém se věnoval aktuálním politickým otázkám, kterým Česká republika čelí. Rozhovor moderuje Vladimír Vokál. (15. července 2026)</media:description>

    <item>
      <title>Juchelka řekl, že kvůli poradkyni nepřijde stát ani o korunu z evropských peněz</title>
      <link>https://www.idnes.cz/zpravy/domaci/juchelka-rekl-ze-kvuli-jeho-byvale-poradkyni-neprijde-stat-ani-o-korunu-z-evropskych-penez.A261016_040151_domaci_kop#utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed&utm_campaign=zpravodaj&utm_content=main</link>
      <description>Ministr práce a sociálních věcí za ANO Aleš Juchelka řekl v pátek poslancům, že kvůli jeho bývalé poradkyni Alexandře Semancové nepřijde země o peníze z EU. „Na Národním plánu obnovy nepřijde Česká republika ani o korunu z evropských peněz,“ prohlásil Juchelka. Kvůli střetu zájmů Semancové má stát podle kontrolorů Nejvyššího kontrolního úřadu nést dodatečné náklady téměř 83 milionů korun.</description>

      <media:description>Ministr práce a sociálních věcí za ANO Aleš Juchelka před jednáním vlády, která má na programu návrh státního rozpočtu na rok 2027 (21. září 2026)</media:description>
      <media:credit>MAFRA</media:credit>
    </item>

    <item>
      <title>V Ostravě dopadli vykrádače sklepů, používal šroubovák a ohýbal zábradlí</title>
      <link>https://www.idnes.cz/ostrava/zpravy/zlodej-sklepy-policie-michalikova-sroubovak.A261016_102958_ostrava-zpravy_jog#utm_source=rss&utm_medium=feed&utm_campaign=zpravodaj&utm_content=main</link>
      <description>Policisté v Ostravě dopadli osmadvacetiletého zloděje, který se specializoval na sklepy v bytových domech zejména v obvodu Přívoz. Hojně využíval šroubovák, a pokud to bylo možné, dařilo se mu i ohnout kovové zábradlí. Ze sklepních kójí pak bral cokoliv cenného, například jízdní kola nebo elektrické nářadí.</description>

      <media:description>Vykrádání sklepů v ostravském obvodu Přívoz by mělo ustat, nebo přinejmenším takových případů ubýt. (16. října 2026)</media:description>

<item>
<title>Česko pomáhá rozhýbat evropský čipový průmysl. Nová služba vývojářům ušetří hromadu práce</title>
<link>https://www.lupa.cz/aktuality/cesko-pomaha-rozhybat-evropsky-cipovy-prumysl-nova-sluzba-vyvojarum-usetri-hromadu-prace/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=text&utm_campaign=rss</link>
<description>Český národní polovodičový klastr ve spolupráci s Českým polovodičovým centrem vytvořily užitečný online nástroj. Jde o katalog takzvaných IP bloků používaných při vývoji čipů. Tyto bloky v katalogu nabízí firmy a organizace z Evropy. Cílem je polovodičovým návrhářům nabídnout jednoduchý přístup ke klíčovým technologiím, které jsou ověřené a rychle nasaditelné a není je nutné vynalézat znovu.</description>

<author>redakce@lupa.cz (Lupa.cz: Jan Sedlák)</author>
<pubDate>Fri, 16 Oct 2026 09:16:18 GMT</pubDate>
<enclosure url="https://i.iinfo.cz/images/343/cipy.png" length='582495' type="image/png"/>
<guid isPermaLink="false">www.lupa.cz-actuality-18611</guid>


</item>
<item>
<title>Miliarda jim trvala tři roky, druhá jen pět měsíců. Českou AI naději už používají Meta, Xiaomi nebo Nvidia</title>
<link>https://www.lupa.cz/aktuality/miliarda-jim-trvala-tri-roky-druha-jen-pet-mesicu-ceskou-ai-nadeji-uz-pouzivaji-meta-xiaomi-nebo-nvidia/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=text&utm_campaign=rss</link>
<description>Český startup E2B aktuálně patří k největ&#353;ím technologickým nadějím země. Pro AI agenty umožňuje velice rychle spou&#353;tět sandboxy, tedy izolovaná prostředí, v nichž agenti mohou běžet, vykonat práci a sandbox následně ukončit. E2B pokračuje v silném růstu. Firma informovala, že jí trvalo tři roky, než u ní zákazníci rozjeli miliardu sandboxů. Teď pokočila metu dvou miliard sandboxů s tím, že druhá miliarda trvala pouze pět měsíců.</description>

<author>redakce@lupa.cz (Lupa.cz: Jan Sedlák)</author>
<pubDate>Fri, 16 Oct 2026 08:51:59 GMT</pubDate>
<enclosure url="https://i.iinfo.cz/images/182/e2b.jpg" length='38895' type="image/jpeg"/>
<guid isPermaLink="false">www.lupa.cz-actuality-18608</guid>


</item>
<item>
<title>Největší česká služba pro online daňové přiznání mění majitele. Umožní nahrát výpisy z investičních aplikací</title>
<link>https://www.lupa.cz/aktuality/nejvetsi-ceska-sluzba-pro-online-danove-priznani-meni-majitele-umozni-nahrat-vypisy-z-investicnich-aplikaci/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=text&utm_campaign=rss</link>
<description>Provozovatel největ&#353;í české služby pro podávání daňového přiznání online mění majitele. Společnost NeoTax, která stojí za službou OnlinePřiznání.cz, od podnikatele Ivo Brabce koupila tuzemský podnik RSM. Z NeoTaxu do RSM přechází celý tým a produkt nadále povede provozní ředitelka Zuzana &#352;elepová.</description>

<link>https://www.lupa.cz/aktuality/oneplay-nataci-serii-veritel-s-martinem-hofmannem/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=text&utm_campaign=rss</link>
<description>Pro Oneplay vzniká v režii Jana Pachla &#353;estidílná série Věřitel. Martin Hofmann v ní hraje emigranta, který se po patnácti letech vrací domů vyrovnat účty s někdej&#353;ími přáteli. Příběh se odehrává v osmdesátých a devadesátých letech. Natáčení potrvá do listopadu, termín premiéry zatím nebyl oznámen.</description>

<item>
 <title>ONLINE: EU nezruší sankce vůči Rusku, dokud Moskva neukončí válku, řekla von der Leyenová</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/online-eu-nezrusi-sankce-vuci-rusku-dokud-moskva-neukonci-valku-rekla-von-der_2610161049_med</link>
 <description>Evropská unie nezruší žádné sankce vůči Rusku, dokud Rusko neukončí svou válku na Ukrajině, uvedla při příchodu na summit EU v Bruselu šéfka Evropské komise Ursula von der Leyenová. Ukrajinský prezident Volodymyr Zelenskyj během společného prohlášení právě se šéfkou EK a předsedou unijních summitů Antóniem Costou poděkoval Evropské unii za podporu. Podpora Ukrajiny je jedním z hlavních témat dnešního jednání.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/uploader/2026-06-09t000000z_1_261016-105212_med.JPG?itok=dRv6jMyv" type="image/jpeg" />
 <pubDate>Fri, 16 Oct 2026 10:49:00 +0200</pubDate>
</item>
<item>
 <title>Dohoda o rozpočtu EU do Vánoc nebude, myslí si Babiš. Rozdíly v pozicích států jsou prý příliš velké</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/dohoda-o-rozpoctu-eu-do-vanoc-nebude-mysli-si-babis-rozdily-v-pozicich-statu_2610161024_kch</link>
 <description>Premiér Andrej Babiš (ANO) se po jednání v Bruselu domnívá, že se lídrům nepodaří dosáhnout dohody o budoucím víceletém rozpočtu EU do konce letošního roku. Stane se tak nejspíš až v únoru či v březnu. Unijní prezidenti a premiéři vedli debatu o svých požadavcích do rozpočtu ve čtvrtek odpoledne a panují mezi nimi zásadní rozdíly. Předseda Evropské rady António Costa přitom několikrát zdůraznil, že doufá v dohodu právě nejpozději v prosinci.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/uploader/2026-07-08t110907z_1_260930-224916_jar.JPG?itok=mj_W6l5d" type="image/jpeg" />
 <pubDate>Fri, 16 Oct 2026 10:24:00 +0200</pubDate>
</item>
<item>
 <title>Po střelbě na základní škole v Oregonu zemřeli tři žáci a vyučující. Útočníka zneškodnil kolemjdoucí</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/po-strelbe-na-zakladni-skole-v-oregonu-zemreli-tri-zaci-a-vyucujici-utocnika_2610160651_lhv</link>
 <description>Tři žáci ve věku pět, osm a jedenáct let a jeden učitel zemřeli po čtvrteční střelbě na základní škole ve městě Bend v americkém státě Oregon, informovala místní policie. Mrtvý je i šestnáctiletý střelec, kterého zastřelil jeden z místních lidí. Další dva zraněné převezly sanitky do nemocnic, uvádí americká média.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/uploader/2026-10-15t230521z_1_261016-062809_lhv.JPG?itok=4QFuIrNm" type="image/jpeg" />
 <pubDate>Fri, 16 Oct 2026 06:51:00 +0200</pubDate>
</item>
<item>
 <title>Extremismus, radikalismus a Die Linke. Politolog ví, proč se krajní levice a pravice v něčem rýmují</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/extremismus-radikalismus-a-die-linke-politolog-vi-proc-se-krajni-levice-a_2610160600_med</link>
 <description>Postkomunistická, antikapitalistická, krajně levicová. Také radikální? A extrémní? Die Linke ovládla Berlín, zatím jen ve volbách, ale vyjednává o koalici. Jak o ní mluvit?</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/images/90f85f895f0a64c39e738c6fdff53faa.jpg?itok=8aQfaDHB" type="image/jpeg" />
 <pubDate>Fri, 16 Oct 2026 06:00:00 +0200</pubDate>
</item>
<item>
 <title>Kalhousová: Izraelci berou volby jako spor o duši země. Zprávy o svých zločinech v Gaze nesou špatně</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/kalhousova-izraelci-berou-volby-jako-spor-o-dusi-zeme-zpravy-o-svych-zlocinech-v_2610160010_brz</link>
 <description>Izrael čekají první volby od začátku současné války v Pásmu Gazy, která začala po teroristickém útoku Hamásu ze 7. října 2023. O novém složení jednokomorového Knesetu rozhodnou voličky a voliči za dva týdny. „Izraelská společnost nevnímá volby pouze jako spor o politické ideje, ale o duši Izraele a o to, jaký jejich stát bude,“ říká pro Český rozhlas Plus ředitelka Herzlova centra izraelských studií na Univerzitě Karlově Irena Kalhousová.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/images/f9f9bfd0f4beb0d16ba645f813422c71.jpg?itok=4JI4Awod" type="image/jpeg" />
 <pubDate>Fri, 16 Oct 2026 00:10:00 +0200</pubDate>
</item>
<item>
 <title>Zmije, chřestýš nebo leguán. Celníci v Německu našli v zavazadle Mexičana 92 hadů a ještěrů</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/zmije-chrestys-nebo-leguan-celnici-v-nemecku-nasli-v-zavazadle-mexicana-92-hadu_2610152345_vsn</link>
 <description>Němečtí celníci našli v zavazadle muže cestujícího z Mexika 37 jedovatých hadů a 55 ještěrů. Muž zvířata ukrýval v plastových nádobách, lahvičkách od šamponů a krémů, ale i v ponožkách. Asi 30 zvířat během cesty nebo krátce po ní uhynulo kvůli nevyhovujícím podmínkám, informovala ve čtvrtek agentura AFP.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/images/03552362.jpeg?itok=e3vgANuU" type="image/jpeg" />
 <pubDate>Thu, 15 Oct 2026 23:45:00 +0200</pubDate>
</item>
<item>
 <title>Zemřeli, protože na zdravotníky čekali moc dlouho. Případ dvou Australanů vyšetřuje záchranná služba</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/zemreli-protoze-na-zdravotniky-cekali-moc-dlouho-pripad-dvou-australanu_2610152235_brz</link>
 <description>Úřady ve státě Queensland na severovýchodě Austrálie začaly vyšetřovat samostatné případy dvou pacientů, kteří v uplynulém týdnu zemřeli při čekání na lékařskou péči. Informoval o tom web ABC.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/images/75a2fc4692ad07e792e0558d4a45b40c.jpg?itok=ncg2GBy0" type="image/jpeg" />
 <pubDate>Thu, 15 Oct 2026 22:35:00 +0200</pubDate>
</item>
<item>
 <title>V eurotunelu se na francouzské straně průlivu srazil autobus s nákladním vlakem, zranilo se 19 lidí</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/v-eurotunelu-se-na-francouzske-strane-prulivu-srazil-autobus-s-nakladnim-vlakem_2610152212_brz</link>
 <description>Srážka autobusu s nákladním vlakem u vjezdu do eurotunelu na francouzské straně Lamanšského průlivu si ve čtvrtek večer vyžádala 19 zraněných. Dva lidé mají vážná zranění, ale nikdo není v ohrožení života, uvedly francouzské úřady. Provoz nákladních vlaků byl v obou směrech dočasně přerušen, osobních vlaků se událost nedotkla, informovala francouzská média. Podle francouzských médií vezl autobus stavební dělníky.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/uploader/profimedia-066991558_261015-214828_brz.jpg?itok=W486zKNt" type="image/jpeg" />
 <pubDate>Thu, 15 Oct 2026 22:12:00 +0200</pubDate>
</item>
<item>
 <title>Na Istanbul udeřily silné deště, voda zaplavila město. Úřady hlásí nejméně dva mrtvé a stovky raněných</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/na-istanbul-uderily-silne-deste-voda-zaplavila-mesto-urady-hlasi-nejmene-dva_2610151856_brz</link>
 <description>Silné deště v tureckém Istanbulu způsobily od středeční noci rozsáhlé záplavy, při nichž zemřeli nejméně dva lidé včetně dospívajícího chlapce. Záchranáři pracovali celou noc na vyproštění stovky lidí, které voda uvěznila na pracovištích, uvedla ve čtvrtek agentura AP. </description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/uploader/profimedia-114359402_261015-175155_brz.jpg?itok=hJR_Rfny" type="image/jpeg" />
 <pubDate>Thu, 15 Oct 2026 18:56:00 +0200</pubDate>
</item>
<item>
 <title>Poprava Nidala Hasana nebude veřejná, oznámil Trump. Zjistil, že je odsouzený od pasu ochrnutý</title>
 <link>https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-svet/poprava-nidala-hasana-nebude-verejna-oznamil-trump-zjistil-ze-je-odsouzeny-od_2610151713_brz</link>
 <description>Poprava někdejšího armádního psychiatra Nidala Hasana, který v roce 2009 zabil na vojenské základně v Texasu 13 lidí a dalších 32 zranil, nakonec nebude přenášena živě. Na své sociální síti Truth Social to ve čtvrtek oznámil americký prezident Donald Trump. Dodal, že vojenskou popravu, která bude provedena zastřelením popravčí četou, budou moci sledovat rodiny obětí.</description>
 <enclosure url="https://www.irozhlas.cz/sites/default/files/styles/zpravy_maly_nahled/public/uploader/2026-10-06t043047z_1_261006-072704_ako.JPG?itok=zv0Cah8Y" type="image/jpeg" />
 <pubDate>Thu, 15 Oct 2026 17:13:00 +0200</pubDate>
</item>

<rss version="2.0" xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><channel><title>Liberecká Drbna</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz</link><description>Liberecká Drbna</description><language>cs</language><item><title>Křižovatka Sněhulák se opět uzavře. Letos už naposledy</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/doprava/903176-krizovatka-snehulak-se-opet-uzavre-letos-uz-naposledy.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/doprava/903176-krizovatka-snehulak-se-opet-uzavre-letos-uz-naposledy.html</guid><pubDate>Fri, 16 Oct 2026 12:12:00 +0200</pubDate><dc:creator>Luboš Vrabec</dc:creator><category>Doprava</category><description>Křižovatku zvanou Sněhulák čeká během páteční noci poslední letošní uzavírka. Důvodem je oprava mostu silnice I/35 nad křižovatkou. Ta se uzavře v pátek v 18 hodin a uzavírka potrvá do sobotní osmé hodiny ráno.</description></item><item><title>Další krok k záchraně barokního dvora zámku Zákupy: Začíná obnova západní části</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/kultura/903165-dalsi-krok-k-zachrane-barokniho-dvora-zamku-zakupy-zacina-obnova-zapadni-casti.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/kultura/903165-dalsi-krok-k-zachrane-barokniho-dvora-zamku-zakupy-zacina-obnova-zapadni-casti.html</guid><pubDate>Fri, 16 Oct 2026 11:00:00 +0200</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Kultura</category><description>Na státním zámku Zákupy začala obnova západní části barokního hospodářského dvora za 242 milionů korun. Práce potrvají do roku 2029 a zajistí stavební záchranu objektu i prostory pro nový archeologický depozitář. Pokračující obnova je dalším krokem k záchraně tohoto unikátního komplexu.</description></item><item><title>Meteorologové prozradili, jaký bude podzim</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/903155-meteorologove-prozradili-jaky-bude-podzim.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/903155-meteorologove-prozradili-jaky-bude-podzim.html</guid><pubDate>Fri, 16 Oct 2026 08:55:00 +0200</pubDate><dc:creator>Markéta Hamerníková</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Deštivého podzimu se zatím obávat nemusíme. Přestože o víkendu na severu Čech zaprší, výhled na dalších sedm až deset dní slibuje převážně suché počasí. Meteorologové očekávají méně srážek, než je pro toto období obvyklé.</description></item><item><title>Nevšední a zábavný: Orfeus v podsvětí v Liberci moderně a se sociálními sítěmi</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/kultura/903164-orfeus-v-podsveti-dostal-v-liberci-moderni-podobu-se-socialnimi-sitemi.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/kultura/903164-orfeus-v-podsveti-dostal-v-liberci-moderni-podobu-se-socialnimi-sitemi.html</guid><pubDate>Fri, 16 Oct 2026 06:30:00 +0200</pubDate><dc:creator>ČTK</dc:creator><category>Kultura</category><description>Do současného jazyka se sociálními sítěmi i mobilními telefony převedlo liberecké divadlo operetu Orfeus v podsvětí od Jacquese Offenbacha. V premiéře uvede dílo o manželských radostech a strastech v sobotu. Větší akcent než v původní verzi bude mít v liberecké úpravě postava Veřejného mínění.</description></item><item><title>Dýně v neděli zaplní centrum Liberce</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/903090-dyne-v-nedeli-zaplni-centrum-liberce.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/903090-dyne-v-nedeli-zaplni-centrum-liberce.html</guid><pubDate>Thu, 15 Oct 2026 20:01:00 +0200</pubDate><dc:creator>Luboš Vrabec</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Náměstí před libereckou radnicí promění v místo podzimní atmosféry, vůní a chutí. Od 10 do 16 hodin se zde uskuteční tradiční Dýňová neděle. Akce nabídne speciální nejen dýňový trh, kulinářskou soutěž, ochutnávky i bohatý doprovodný program pro děti i dospělé. Vstup je zdarma.</description></item><item><title>V Kauflandu v Jablonci našli inspektoři výživu dřív stahovanou z prodeje kvůli toxinu</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/zdravi/903149-v-kauflandu-v-jablonci-nasli-inspektori-vyzivu-driv-stahovanou-z-prodeje-kvuli-toxinu.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/zdravi/903149-v-kauflandu-v-jablonci-nasli-inspektori-vyzivu-driv-stahovanou-z-prodeje-kvuli-toxinu.html</guid><pubDate>Thu, 15 Oct 2026 18:53:00 +0200</pubDate><dc:creator>ČTK</dc:creator><category>Zdraví</category><description>Kojenecké výživy značky Nutrilon, dříve stahované z prodeje kvůli podezření na výskyt toxinu cereulid, se opětovně objevily v některých prodejnách Kauflandu, například v Jablonci nad Nisou. Státní zemědělská a potravinářská inspekce (SZPI) to zjistila při cílené kontrole tří prodejen společnosti.</description></item><item><title>Víte, zda vaše dítě sedí v autě skutečně bezpečně? Přijďte to zjistit do OC NISA</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/doprava/902951-vite-zda-vase-dite-sedi-v-aute-skutecne-bezpecne-prijdte-to-zjistit-do-oc-nisa.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/doprava/902951-vite-zda-vase-dite-sedi-v-aute-skutecne-bezpecne-prijdte-to-zjistit-do-oc-nisa.html</guid><pubDate>Thu, 15 Oct 2026 17:56:00 +0200</pubDate><category>Doprava</category><description>Správně nainstalovaná autosedačka, správně usazené dítě a správně dotažené pásy – tři podmínky, které musí být splněny zároveň, aby autosedačka při nehodě plnila svou funkci. Přitom právě v těchto detailech rodiče nejčastěji chybují, aniž by o tom věděli.</description></item><item><title>V Liberci vyrostlo největší solární parkoviště v Česku. Je v areálu DENSO</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/903139-v-liberci-vyrostlo-nejvetsi-solarni-parkoviste-v-cesku-je-v-arealu-denso.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/903139-v-liberci-vyrostlo-nejvetsi-solarni-parkoviste-v-cesku-je-v-arealu-denso.html</guid><pubDate>Thu, 15 Oct 2026 16:00:00 +0200</pubDate><dc:creator>Martina Petrášková</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Největší solární parkoviště v ČR vyrostlo v areálu DENSO v průmyslové zóně v Liberci. Takzvaný carport tvoří 2 706 solárních panelů, jejich výkon bude 1,8 MWp, zaparkovat pod nimi může 482 aut. Firma tak využila parkoviště k výrobě zelené energie, zároveň zlepšila komfort parkování pro zaměstnance.</description></item><item><title>Arsenal má náhradu za odvolaného Mathausera. Přichází Chorvat Matić</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/fotbal/903138-arsenal-ma-nahradu-za-odvolaneho-mathausera-prichazi-chorvat-mati.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/fotbal/903138-arsenal-ma-nahradu-za-odvolaneho-mathausera-prichazi-chorvat-mati.html</guid><pubDate>Thu, 15 Oct 2026 14:42:09 +0200</pubDate><dc:creator>Luboš Vrabec</dc:creator><category>Fotbal</category><description>Českolipský Arsenal představil trenéra, který nahradí odvolaného Petra Mathausera. Do Česka přichází zcela nové trenérské jméno – sedmačtyřicetiletý Chorvat Stipe Matić. Ten má trenérské zkušenosti ze švýcarského Thunu. Naposledy pracoval jako skaut.</description></item><item><title>Zajímavost voleb. Hned několik obcí s lyžařskými středisky čeká výměna starosty</title><link>https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/903077-krkonosskou-rokytnici-benecko-vitkovice-a-asi-i-harrachov-ceka-vymena.html</link><guid isPermaLink="true">https://liberecka.drbna.cz/spolecnost/903077-krkonosskou-rokytnici-benecko-vitkovice-a-asi-i-harrachov-ceka-vymena.html</guid><pubDate>Thu, 15 Oct 2026 14:30:00 +0200</pubDate><dc:creator>ČTK</dc:creator><category>Společnost</category><description>Nového starostu bude mít většina obcí se známými lyžařskými areály v Libereckém kraji. Jiného budou mít krkonošská střediska Rokytnice nad Jizerou, Benecko, Vítkovice a nejspíš i Harrachov. V jizerskohorském Bedřichově možná zůstane stávající, povolební vyjednávání tam ale ještě neskončila.</description></item></channel></rss>
